# THE PACKET-VOID OWED LEDGER (tools/casegate; the format is
# internal/inputfamilies.Family.Owed's, the one every shared-corpus family
# uses). One line per case a leg does not answer yet,
# `<leg> <case> owed: <cause>`, or `<leg> all owed: <cause>` for a leg with
# no packet-void driver; every line carries its cause. An exact set on every
# line: a leg that is not one of the 18 legs, a case cases.txt does not name,
# a line there twice, and a line for a case the leg answers ok are red until
# the line is fixed or removed, and a leg or case with no line that does not
# answer is red.
lua mixed-write-payload-type owed: the generated Lua writer has no payload shape check; an integer payload raises "attempt to index a number value", not the writer refusal
squirrel mixed-write-payload-type owed: the generated Squirrel writer has no payload shape check; an integer payload raises "the index EntriesCount does not exist", not the writer refusal
elixir mixed-write-payload-type owed: the generated Elixir writer has no payload shape check; an integer payload raises MatchError, not the writer refusal
